title: Varbase Media JSON Schema definitions
description: Reusable prop shapes for components consuming Varbase Media data, including a drimage-aware image payload and the media view modes enum.

image.title: Varbase Media image
image.description: Image payload mirroring canvas.module/image, extended with optional drimage_improved data + media view mode.

data.title: Drimage data
data.description: Drimage_improved data object enabling responsive client-side rendering via vartheme_bs5:dynamic-responsive-image.

media-view-mode.title: Media view mode
media-view-mode.description: Machine name of a media view mode. Populated at runtime by Drupal\varbase_media\MediaViewModesList for components that need a dropdown of view modes.
